title: Repo-wide guards in scoped task QA, the assetgen model-hash cache writer, doctor output cleanup

tasks.grade_reason: the scoped task QA every plan runs; a missing guard lets a breach reach CI, an extra one slows every task
tasks.objective: Backlog topic test-flakes-followups (docs/plans/backlog.md). In plan test-flakes, scoped task QA (`tests/run-all.sh --affected --base <b> --within <suites> -j 1`) let two breaches through that only the merged tree caught: placeholder user paths in new test fixtures (the `Portable-paths enforcement` run line, `scripts/checks/portable-paths.py --enforce`) and README text that tripped the workspace reader guard of tests/workspace-default.test.sh. (1) In tests/run-all.sh, make a `--within` run also run the repo-wide enforcement lines whenever the change reaches them: `English-only enforcement` and `Portable-paths enforcement` (each takes seconds; they are scripts with EXTRA ['*'] in tests/affected.py, so any change reaches them). Do not add whole suites: the reader guard lives inside tests/workspace-default.test.sh; if that guard can run alone cheaply (a case or a script it calls), add that one case under the same rule, otherwise say so. (2) tests/affected.py: the netcode evidence prune case lives in tests/run-all-parallel.test.sh and sources `prune_evidence` from scripts/checks/netcode-headless.sh, but a change to that script does not select it; map it (EXTRA or a case-map line of tests/run-all-parallel.test.sh, whichever the suite uses). Cases in tests/run-all-parallel.test.sh and tests/affected.test.sh: a --within run of an unrelated suite still runs both enforcement lines and fails on a planted portable-paths breach; a netcode-headless.sh change selects the prune case. Changelog fragment changelog.d/qa-guards-within.md (### Changed). Do not edit scripts/factory-pipeline.py (another plan owns it). CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine. The machine is short on memory: run one test command at a time with -j 1; stop your own test run before you report.
acceptance: a --within run also runs the English-only and portable-paths enforcement lines when the change reaches them, and fails on a breach
a change to scripts/checks/netcode-headless.sh selects the netcode prune case

tasks.grade_reason: a new assetgen command that writes Factory state; it must stay out of product repos and handle multi-GB files
tasks.objective: Backlog topic assetgen-run-followups (docs/plans/backlog.md): no command writes the model-hash cache. `scripts/assetgen/assetgen.py` `model_hashes` (around line 700) reads `<persistent state dir>/comfy/model-hashes.json` (or ASSETGEN_MODEL_HASHES), schema `rpg-factory.comfy-model-hashes/1`, rows with kind, name and sha256, so the manifest records local model sha256 as unverified and the assetgen check warns. Add a command (e.g. `assetgen.py model-hashes [--models-dir <dir>] [--kind <k>]`) that hashes the local ComfyUI model files of the kinds asset-gen uses and writes that cache through scripts/lib/fstate.py (never $TMPDIR directly, never into a product repo, never into the ComfyUI install). Model files are multi-GB: hash in streamed chunks, and reuse an existing row when the file's size and mtime are unchanged (store both in the row; keep the schema version unless a new field needs a bump, and say which). Resolve the models directory the way skills/comfy-desktop-setup/SKILL.md and the comfy-mcp setup describe (Desktop and headless installs); with no directory found, exit with a clear message. Update skills/comfy-desktop-setup/SKILL.md (the 'No command writes the model-hash cache yet' item) and the assetgen usage text. Cases in tests/assetgen.test.sh with small fake model files (no real models, no network): first write, reuse on unchanged size and mtime, rehash on change, the reader then records the sha256 as verified. Changelog fragment changelog.d/qa-guards-model-hashes.md (### Added). CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine. The machine is short on memory: run one test command at a time with -j 1; stop your own test run before you report.
acceptance: a command writes the model-hash cache under the Factory state dir with streamed hashing and size/mtime reuse
after it runs, the manifest records the local model sha256 as verified
the comfy-desktop-setup skill and assetgen usage describe the command
